what_to_do.en: Tap the word that means the same.

stages.choice_rule: Four single words. Exactly one is a synonym of the one quoted word in the stem. The other three are wrong: an antonym, an unrelated kid-world word, or a same-topic near miss. All choices come from the roots wordlist or allowed_extra_words. Never repeat the quoted target as a choice. Never put two valid synonyms in the same choice set. Keep one right answer.

roots: Give four single words. Exactly one means the same as the quoted word in the stem.
Wrong choices must come from the roots wordlist or allowed_extra_words. Never invent off-list words.
Never reuse the quoted target as a choice, and never put two true synonyms in one choice set.
Tier 1 distractors are clear antonyms or unrelated kid-world words. Add a lemma picture when the stem has a concrete noun.
Tier 2 distractors share part of speech with the target and may include a clear antonym.
Tier 3 distractors are same-topic near misses such as family words, speech verbs, or classroom things that do not mean the same.
Keep stems in kid world: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands. No real names; use <NAME>.
Quote exactly one target word in every stem. One right answer. Tap only.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words with one quoted target. Use obvious antonyms or unrelated distractors. Add a lemma picture for a concrete noun.
tier_rules.2: Grade-level stems of five to eight words. Two-syllable targets are fine. Distractors share part of speech with the quoted word.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss distractors from the same topic as the target, such as family words or classroom things that do not mean the same.

size_same.en: The quoted word tells a size. Pick the other size word that means the same.
size_same.ko: 따옴표 안 낱말은 크기를 말합니다. 같은 뜻인 크기 낱말을 고르세요.
